GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (10 Dec 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1385)
APO 500
10 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 7 September 1946, file AG 000.5 (7 Sep 46)LS-R, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one MIKI (FNU) Col., to the Commanding General, FIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is amended to delete said MIKI's name for the reason that he is presently incarcerated in STNGAPORE. This name appears as the first name on Page No. 5 of the above-mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
